## Anaerobic oxidation of methane supports a minimal microbial community in a subsurface biofilm at Ginsburg mud volcano

Ginsburg 泥火山深部生物膜的简化甲烷氧化群落

Collado, C., Romero-Tena, P., Wegener, G., Elvert, M., Menapace, W., & Laso-Pérez, R. (2026). Anaerobic oxidation of methane supports a minimal microbial community in a subsurface biofilm at Ginsburg mud volcano. *ISME Communications, 6*(1), Article ycag072. https://doi.org/10.1093/ismeco/ycag072

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Ginsburg Mud Volcano, Gulf of Cádiz; fracture biofilm around 9.5–9.7 m below seafloor at 1,126 m water depth.

加的斯湾 Ginsburg 泥火山，水深 1,126 m、海底以下约 9.5–9.7 m 的裂隙生物膜。

**Design / 研究设计**: Compare biofilm and adjacent sediment using metagenomes, lipid biomarkers, isotopes and porewater chemistry.

利用宏基因组、脂质标志物、同位素与孔隙水化学比较生物膜及邻近沉积物。

**Finding / 发现**: A deeply buried SMTZ biofilm was dominated by ANME-1b with a less abundant Seep-SRB1c partner and few inferred heterotrophs.

深埋 SMTZ 生物膜由 ANME-1b 占优，伴随较少 Seep-SRB1c 伙伴及少数推定异养微生物。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: The fracture-specific, sulfate-supplied niche does not establish a universal deep-sediment community or a measured methane-removal rate.

该裂隙特定、持续供应硫酸盐的生态位不能代表普遍深层沉积物群落或实测甲烷去除速率。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Compare ANME depth niches while accounting for fractures and sulfate supplied from below.

比较 ANME 深度生态位时，考虑裂隙及来自下方的硫酸盐供应。

Sampling time / 采样时间：2018 drilling samples; 2026 publication. 2018 年钻探样品，2026 年发表。

Evidence access / 核查材料：full_text_extracts; reviewed / 核查日期：2026-10-13.

Evidence locator / 证据位置：Abstract; Methods: Study area and Sample collection and geochemistry.

摘要；方法：研究区、样品采集与地球化学。

## Carbon monoxide oxidation expands the known metabolic capacity in anaerobic methanotrophic consortia

哥斯达黎加来源 ANME–SRB 联合体的 CO 氧化与维持代谢

Guo, Y., Utter, D. R., Murali, R., & Orphan, V. J. (2026). Carbon monoxide oxidation expands the known metabolic capacity in anaerobic methanotrophic consortia. *Nature Communications, 17*(1), Article 3461. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-71433-9

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Jaco Scar seep sediments off Costa Rica, collected at 1,811 m water depth.

哥斯达黎加外海 Jaco Scar 冷泉沉积物，采样水深 1,811 m。

**Design / 研究设计**: Anoxic microcosms with CO, isotope tracers, metatranscriptomics and FISH–NanoSIMS measurements.

采用 CO 厌氧微宇宙、同位素示踪、宏转录组及 FISH–NanoSIMS 测量。

**Finding / 发现**: ANME–SRB consortia oxidized CO without methane; sulfate availability altered the electron sink, and single-cell results favored maintenance over active growth.

ANME–SRB 联合体在无甲烷时氧化 CO；硫酸盐可用性改变电子汇，单细胞结果偏向细胞维持而非活跃生长。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: CO-amended microcosms establish metabolic flexibility, without showing the field prevalence or flux contribution of this pathway in SCS seeps.

CO 添加微宇宙证明代谢灵活性，未确定该途径在南海冷泉的现场普遍性或通量贡献。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Use a recent experimental precedent for ANME persistence under changing substrate supply, with growth and maintenance distinguished.

为底物供应改变时 ANME 的持续存在提供近期实验先例，并区分生长与维持。

Sampling time / 采样时间：May 2017 samples; published in 2026. 2017 年 5 月样品，2026 年发表。

Evidence access / 核查材料：full_text_extracts; reviewed / 核查日期：2026-10-13.

Evidence locator / 证据位置：Abstract; Methods: Sediment collection and processing and Medium composition.

摘要；方法：沉积物采集处理与培养基组成。

[Inspected source / 核查来源](https://europepmc.org/article/MED/41980960) · `src:gcs-costa-rica-co-consortia` · Mechanistic precedent / 机制先例

## Co-occurrence of diverse defense systems shapes complex microbe-virus relationships in deep-sea cold seeps

全球冷泉防御与抗防御系统及功能验证

Han, Y., Liao, J., Li, C., Xing, F., Peng, J., Liu, X., Xie, W., Wu, F., Jian, H., Cheng, R., & Dong, X. (2026). Co-occurrence of diverse defense systems shapes complex microbe-virus relationships in deep-sea cold seeps. *Nature Communications, 17*(1), Article 1427. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-68174-6

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Seventeen global seep sites; SCS data contribute to the comparative catalog.

17 个全球冷泉站；南海数据参与比较目录。

**Design / 研究设计**: Compare microbial/viral defense genes and test selected candidate defenses in laboratory systems.

比较微生物／病毒防御基因，并在实验室系统测试选定候选防御。

**Finding / 发现**: Extensive defense/anti-defense diversity was detected, and selected candidate systems protected experimental hosts.

检测到丰富防御／抗防御多样性，选定候选系统保护实验宿主。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Genomic co-occurrence does not prove ecological interactions, and laboratory protection does not establish native fitness effects.

基因组共现不能证明生态互作，实验室保护不能确定天然适合度效应。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Reuse the global comparison for viral-defense discussions while keeping native ecological inference separate from laboratory validation.

复用全球比较进行病毒防御讨论，并区分天然生态推断与实验室验证。

## Methanotrophy dominated symbiosis in novel species Gigantidas niobengalensis from the cold seeps of Krishna–Godavari basin

克里希纳–戈达瓦里冷泉贻贝鳃的甲烷氧化菌群

Sangodkar, N., Gonsalves, M. J., & Nazareth, D. R. (2026). Methanotrophy dominated symbiosis in novel species *Gigantidas niobengalensis* from the cold seeps of krishna–godavari basin. *FEMS Microbes, 7*, Article xtag014. https://doi.org/10.1093/femsmc/xtag014

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Gigantidas niobengalensis from Krishna–Godavari basin, Bay of Bengal, at 1,754.5 m water depth.

孟加拉湾克里希纳–戈达瓦里盆地、水深 1,754.5 m 的 Gigantidas niobengalensis。

**Design / 研究设计**: Gill 16S amplicons and PICRUSt functional predictions, with culturable counts and seven-day macerated-tissue methane incubations.

鳃 16S 扩增子与 PICRUSt 功能预测，结合可培养计数及七天组织匀浆甲烷培养。

**Finding / 发现**: Gill communities were methanotroph-rich, and methane consumption was observed in amended tissue incubations under the reported oxygen treatments.

鳃群落富集甲烷氧化相关类群，在所报道供氧处理的添加底物组织培养中观察到甲烷消耗。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Methods specify amplicons and predicted functions despite metagenomic terminology; tissue-vial consumption does not localize in vivo symbiont flux.

尽管使用宏基因组术语，方法实际为扩增子与功能预测；组织瓶培养消耗不能定位体内共生菌通量。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Compare Indian Ocean gill microbiomes with SCS mussels while matching marker-based functions and tissue-incubation conditions.

将印度洋贻贝鳃菌群与南海比较时，对齐标记推断功能与组织培养条件。

Sampling time / 采样时间：March 2018 sampling; 2026 publication. 2018 年 3 月采样，2026 年发表。

Evidence locator / 证据位置：Methods: Sampling; Methane oxidation activity; Metagenomics sequencing and taxonomic profiling; Functional annotation.

## Microbial and geochemical architecture of an active Scotian Slope cold seep

斯科舍陆坡冷泉的微生物与地球化学空间结构

Redshaw, E., Oueslati, G., Umoh, U. U., MacAdam, N., Granados, P., Bentley, J. N., Ahangarian, N., Bennett, R., Baghalabadi, V., Fowler, M. G., MacDonald, A., Hubert, C. R. J., & Ventura, G. T. (2026). Microbial and geochemical architecture of an active Scotian Slope cold seep. *Frontiers in Microbiology, 17*, Article 1709097. https://doi.org/10.3389/fmicb.2026.1709097

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Seep 2A-1 on the Scotian Slope, about 2,500 m water depth, with six cores along a 600-m transect.

斯科舍陆坡 2A-1 冷泉，水深约 2,500 m，沿 600 m 样带取六根岩芯。

**Design / 研究设计**: Profile porewater, carbon isotopes and archaeal lipid classes across seep and nearby sediments to at most 40 cm below seafloor.

在冷泉及邻近沉积物中分析孔隙水、碳同位素与古菌脂质类别，最大海底以下深度 40 cm。

**Finding / 发现**: Porewater and lipid proxies resolved lateral and vertical metabolic zonation, including an ANME-associated region surrounded by sulfate-reduction signals.

孔隙水与脂质代用指标识别出侧向和垂向代谢分区，包括被硫酸盐还原信号包围的 ANME 相关区域。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Lipid proxies identify inferred community/metabolic structure rather than direct lineage-specific activity or metagenomic gene abundance.

脂质代用指标给出推断的群落与代谢结构，并非谱系特定活性或宏基因组基因丰度的直接测量。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Use a recent Atlantic comparison for spatial heterogeneity and porewater-supported microbial zonation.

提供近期大西洋比较，用于讨论空间异质性及孔隙水支持的微生物分区。

Sampling time / 采样时间：2021 ROV collection; 2026 publication. 2021 年 ROV 采样，2026 年发表。

Evidence access / 核查材料：full_text_extracts; reviewed / 核查日期：2026-10-13.

Evidence locator / 证据位置：Methods: Sample collection and Lipid biomarker proxies; Abstract; Correction note states minor changes do not alter scientific content.

## Cold Seeps and Coral Reefs in Northern Norway: Carbon Cycling in Marine Ecosystems With Coexisting Features

挪威冷泉与冷水珊瑚邻近水体的碳与 DOM

Sert, M. F., Bernstein, H. C., Dølven, K. O., Petters, S., Kekäläinen, T., Jänis, J., Corrales‐Guerrero, J., & Ferré, B. (2025). Cold seeps and coral reefs in northern Norway: Carbon cycling in marine ecosystems with coexisting features. *Journal of Geophysical Research: Biogeosciences, 130*(3), Article e2024JG008475. https://doi.org/10.1029/2024jg008475

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Hola trough on northern Norway's shelf, where cold seeps coexist with cold-water corals.

挪威北部陆架 Hola 海槽，冷泉与冷水珊瑚共存。

**Design / 研究设计**: Characterize water carbon isotopes, nutrients, dissolved organic matter and microbial diversity.

表征水体碳同位素、营养盐、溶解有机质及微生物多样性。

**Finding / 发现**: Near-seep waters had higher dissolved inorganic carbon and modified DOM/isotope patterns, interpreted alongside hydrophysical and particle controls.

近冷泉水体具有较高溶解无机碳及改变的 DOM／同位素模式，并结合水动力和颗粒控制解释。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Association of DOM and microbes does not directly measure transfer of microbial carbon to corals or establish a warming response.

DOM 与微生物关联未直接测定微生物碳向珊瑚传递或确定升温响应。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Compare nutrient and organic-carbon context of SCS seep water without treating community associations as food transfer.

比较南海冷泉水的营养盐及有机碳背景，并保留群落关联与食物传递的证据差异。

Evidence access / 核查材料：publisher_abstract; reviewed / 核查日期：2026-10-13.

Evidence locator / 证据位置：Publisher Abstract and Data Availability Statement.

出版方摘要与数据可用性说明。

## Cold seeps are potential hotspots of deep-sea nitrogen loss driven by microorganisms across 21 phyla

冷泉氮损失的区域培养证据与全球基因组比较

Jiang, Q., Cao, L., Han, Y., Li, S., Zhao, R., Zhang, X., Ruff, S. E., Zhao, Z., Peng, J., Liao, J., Zhu, B., Wang, M., Lin, X., & Dong, X. (2025). Cold seeps are potential hotspots of deep-sea nitrogen loss driven by microorganisms across 21 phyla. *Nature Communications, 16*(1), Article 1646. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-56774-1

**Study scope / 研究范围**: SCS seep/reference sediment rate experiments, paired with 165 metagenomes from 16 global seep areas.

南海冷泉与参照沉积物速率实验，配对全球 16 个冷泉区域的 165 份宏基因组。

**Design / 研究设计**: Combine 15N-amended slurries and geochemistry with denitrification/anammox gene catalogs and MAG analyses.

联合 15N 添加泥浆培养、地球化学与反硝化／厌氧氨氧化基因目录和 MAG 分析。

**Finding / 发现**: SCS incubations documented nitrogen-loss potential, while the global catalog extended the inferred taxonomic distribution of nitrogen-loss genes.

南海培养记录氮损失潜力，全球目录则拓展氮损失基因的推定分类分布。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Experimental rates originate from SCS sediments; global genomic occurrence and extrapolated fluxes are separate evidence and do not measure all regions.

实验速率来自南海沉积物；全球基因组出现情况及外推通量是不同证据，未实测全部海区。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Discuss global nitrogen-cycling capacity while retaining the actual geographic origin of measured rates.

讨论全球氮循环能力时，保留实测速率的真实地域来源。

Evidence access / 核查材料：full_text_extracts; reviewed / 核查日期：2026-10-13.

Evidence locator / 证据位置：Methods: Sampling and geochemical measurements; Determination of nitrogen loss rates; Metagenomic data processing.

## Diversity and Distribution of Hydrocarbon-Degrading Genes in the Cold Seeps from the Mediterranean and Caspian Seas

地中海与里海冷泉沉积物的烃降解基因比较

Warkhade, Y., Schaerer, L. G., Bigcraft, I., Hazen, T. C., & Techtmann, S. M. (2025). Diversity and distribution of hydrocarbon-degrading genes in the cold seeps from the Mediterranean and Caspian seas. *Microorganisms, 13*(2), Article 222. https://doi.org/10.3390/microorganisms13020222

**Study scope / 研究范围**: North Alexandria Mud Volcano in the Eastern Mediterranean and southern Caspian sediments.

东地中海北亚历山大泥火山及南里海沉积物。

**Design / 研究设计**: Use 16S rRNA sequencing, depth-resolved metagenomes and pathway annotation across contrasting oxygen and salinity regimes.

跨不同氧与盐度条件，结合 16S rRNA、深度分层宏基因组及途径注释。

**Finding / 发现**: Hydrocarbon-degrading gene inventories differed between basins and with depth, with stronger aerobic potential near the Mediterranean surface and anaerobic potential in Caspian sediments.

烃降解基因组成随海盆与深度变化；地中海表层偏向有氧潜力，里海沉积物偏向厌氧潜力。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Gene inventories do not quantify degradation rates; different sample histories and basin conditions complicate a geographic attribution.

基因组成不能量化降解速率；不同样品历史与海盆条件限制将差异归因于地域。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Compare hydrocarbon potential under documented redox conditions instead of treating all cold-seep sediments as equivalent.

在已记录的氧化还原条件下比较烃代谢潜力，保留不同冷泉沉积物的环境差异。

Sampling time / 采样时间：Mediterranean samples from October 2012; Caspian samples from 2013; paper published in 2025. 地中海样品采于 2012 年 10 月，里海样品采于 2013 年，论文发表于 2025 年。

## Global Distribution Patterns of Dark Matter Fungi in Cold Seep: A Metagenomic Meta-Analysis

全球冷泉真菌的宏基因组地理分布比较

Zhang, Z.-F., Jiang, Y., & Mao, J. (2025). Global distribution patterns of dark matter fungi in cold seep: A metagenomic meta-analysis. *Journal of Fungi, 11*(12), Article 878. https://doi.org/10.3390/jof11120878

**Study scope / 研究范围**: 105 sediment metagenomes from 12 seep sites; 66 SCS samples and smaller Pacific, Gulf of Mexico, Atlantic and Arctic subsets.

Kleindienst, S., Polerecky, L., Amann, R., Musat, F., & Knittel, K. (2025). **Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Use when evaluating tide, season and water-column mixing as sampling controls on SCS microbial methane filters.

**Design / 研究设计**: Compare taxonomic composition and methane/sulfur pathway expression in paired DNA/RNA datasets.

在配对 DNA／RNA 数据中比较分类组成及甲烷／硫途径表达。

**Finding / 发现**: ANME-1 and ANME-2 dominated different seep fluids, with different sulfur-related transcript patterns despite methane metabolism expression in both.

ANME-1 与 ANME-2 在不同冷泉流体中占优，尽管两者均表达甲烷代谢，硫相关转录模式不同。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Transcripts support expressed potential; proposed polysulfide coupling and bacterial independence require direct physiological validation.

转录本支持表达潜力；所提出的多硫化物耦合及细菌独立性需要直接生理验证。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Compare DNA and RNA evidence and avoid assigning identical sulfur partners to every SCS ANME clade.

比较 DNA 与 RNA 证据，讨论不同南海 ANME 支系可能具有不同硫伙伴。

## Metabolic potential of uncultured bacteria and archaea associated with petroleum seepage in deep-sea sediments

东墨西哥湾石油冷泉的未培养微生物代谢潜力

Dong, X., Greening, C., Rattray, J. E., Chakraborty, A., Chuvochina, M., Mayumi, D., Dolfing, J., Li, C., Brooks, J. M., Bernard, B. B., Groves, R. A., Lewis, I. A., & Hubert, C. R. J. (2019). Metabolic potential of uncultured bacteria and archaea associated with petroleum seepage in deep-sea sediments. *Nature Communications, 10*(1), Article 1816. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-019-09747-0

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Three Eastern Gulf of Mexico petroleum seeps at about 3 km water depth.

水深约 3 km 的东墨西哥湾三处石油冷泉。

**Design / 研究设计**: Recover 82 MAGs and combine genome annotations with sediment chemistry, metabolites and thermodynamic modeling.

恢复 82 个 MAG，联合基因组注释、沉积物化学、代谢物与热力学模型。

**Finding / 发现**: Diverse uncultured lineages encoded anaerobic hydrocarbon, acetate and hydrogen metabolism consistent with petroleum-fed community networks.

多样未培养谱系编码厌氧烃、乙酸与氢代谢，符合石油供给群落网络。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Inferred acetate/hydrogen exchanges and thermodynamic feasibility are not direct partner-transfer measurements.

推定乙酸／氢交换及热力学可行性并非伙伴传递的直接测量。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Compare the range of organic substrates and inferred metabolite exchanges in SCS metagenomes.

比较南海宏基因组中的有机底物范围及推定代谢物交换。

## Decoupling between sulfate reduction and the anaerobic oxidation of methane in the shallow methane seep of the Black sea

黑海浅水冷泉硫酸盐还原与甲烷氧化的脱耦

Tarnovetskii, I. Y., Merkel, A. Y., Kanapatskiy, T. A., Ivanova, E. A., Gulin, M. B., Toshchakov, S., & Pimenov, N. V. (2018). Decoupling between sulfate reduction and the anaerobic oxidation of methane in the shallow methane seep of the Black Sea. *FEMS Microbiology Letters, 365*(21). https://doi.org/10.1093/femsle/fny235

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Shallow gas seepages in Kalamit Bay, Black Sea.

黑海 Kalamit 湾浅水气体渗漏。

**Design / 研究设计**: Pair 16S profiles with 14C/35S assays of methane oxidation and sulfate reduction.

将 16S 剖面与甲烷氧化、硫酸盐还原的 14C／35S 实验配对。

**Finding / 发现**: Sulfate reduction rates greatly exceeded anaerobic methane oxidation, indicating additional contributors to sulfide production in the sampled sediments.

硫酸盐还原速率远高于厌氧甲烷氧化，提示所采沉积物硫化物生成还有其他来源。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: A shallow coastal rate study cannot directly represent deep-sea settings, and maximum rates are not paired pathway stoichiometry.

浅海沿岸速率研究不能直接代表深海，最大速率也并非配对途径化学计量。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Support discussion of sulfur cycling beyond methane-coupled sulfate reduction.

支持讨论甲烷耦合硫酸盐还原之外的硫循环。

## Comparative metagenomics of hydrocarbon and methane seeps of the Gulf of Mexico

墨西哥湾油气冷泉与甲烷冷泉的比较宏基因组

Vigneron, A., Alsop, E. B., Cruaud, P., Philibert, G., King, B., Baksmaty, L., Lavallée, D., P. Lomans, B., Kyrpides, N. C., Head, I. M., & Tsesmetzis, N. (2017). Comparative metagenomics of hydrocarbon and methane seeps of the Gulf of Mexico. *Scientific Reports, 7*(1), Article 16015. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-017-16375-5

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Three Mississippi Canyon sites, Gulf of Mexico, at 1,055–1,129 m water depth.

墨西哥湾密西西比峡谷三站，水深 1,055–1,129 m。

**Design / 研究设计**: Duplicate push cores per site; microbial samples at 3–4 and 10–12 cm below seafloor, with marker genes, shotgun sequencing and hydrocarbon chemistry.

每站重复推芯，微生物样品取海底以下 3–4 与 10–12 cm，结合标记基因、鸟枪法测序与烃化学。

**Finding / 发现**: Methane-dominated sediments had abundant ANME-1 and methane-oxidation potential, whereas oil-containing sediments favored different lineages and complex-hydrocarbon degradation genes.

甲烷占优沉积物具有丰富 ANME-1 与甲烷氧化潜力；含油沉积物则偏向不同类群及复杂烃降解基因。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: Community and gene differences support substrate-associated potential, without proving independent ANME oxidation or measuring field process rates.

群落与基因差异支持底物相关功能潜力，不能证明 ANME 独立氧化或确定现场过程速率。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Compare substrate composition and seep–background contrasts before attributing an SCS community difference to geography.

比较底物组成及冷泉与背景差异，再讨论南海群落差异是否与地域有关。

Sampling time / 采样时间：October 2015 sampling; published in 2017. 2015 年 10 月采样，2017 年发表。

## Relative Abundance and Diversity of Bacterial Methanotrophs at the Oxic–Anoxic Interface of the Congo Deep-Sea Fan

刚果深海扇氧化还原界面的甲烷氧化菌背景比较

Bessette, S., Moalic, Y., Gautey, S., Lesongeur, F., Godfroy, A., & Toffin, L. (2017). Relative abundance and diversity of bacterial methanotrophs at the oxic–anoxic interface of the Congo deep-sea fan. *Frontiers in Microbiology, 8*, Article 715. https://doi.org/10.3389/fmicb.2017.00715

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Congo-Angola deep-sea fan lobes around 5,000 m water depth, including habitats resembling cold seeps.

刚果–安哥拉深海扇，水深约 5,000 m，包括类似冷泉的生境。

**Design / 研究设计**: Use FISH and pmoA sequence comparison at sediment oxic–anoxic interfaces of river-connected and disconnected lobes.

在河流连通与不连通扇体的沉积物氧化–缺氧界面采用 FISH 与 pmoA 序列比较。

**Finding / 发现**: Diverse aerobic methanotrophs occurred in organic-rich active fan habitats; cells or pmoA were not detected in the disconnected older lobe.

富有机质活跃扇体生境存在多样有氧甲烷氧化菌；不连通老扇体未检出细胞或 pmoA。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: This is a seep-like depositional comparison, and marker detection does not measure methane removal or prove dispersal routes.

这是类似冷泉的沉积环境比较，标记检测未测定甲烷去除或证明扩散路径。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Provide context for organic supply and interface methanotroph diversity without assigning it to a conventional active seep.

为有机物供应及界面甲烷氧化菌多样性提供背景，并保留其与典型活跃冷泉的区别。

## Short-chain alkanes fuel mussel and sponge Cycloclasticus symbionts from deep-sea gas and oil seeps

墨西哥湾贻贝与海绵 Cycloclasticus 共生菌的短链烷烃利用

Rubin-Blum, M., Antony, C. P., Borowski, C., Sayavedra, L., Pape, T., Sahling, H., Bohrmann, G., Kleiner, M., Redmond, M. C., Valentine, D. L., & Dubilier, N. (2017). Short-chain alkanes fuel mussel and sponge *Cycloclasticus symbionts* from deep-sea gas and oil seeps. *Nature Microbiology, 2*(8), Article 17093. https://doi.org/10.1038/nmicrobiol.2017.93

**Study scope / 研究范围**: Mussels and sponges at asphalt-rich Campeche Knolls oil seeps, southern Gulf of Mexico.

南墨西哥湾 Campeche Knolls 富沥青石油冷泉的贻贝与海绵。

**Design / 研究设计**: Examine symbiont genomes, transcripts and local short-chain hydrocarbons.

分析共生菌基因组、转录本与当地短链烃。

**Finding / 发现**: Symbiotic Cycloclasticus lacked the expected PAH-degradation repertoire and instead showed short-chain-alkane metabolic potential and expression.

共生 Cycloclasticus 缺乏预期 PAH 降解组成，转而显示短链烷烃代谢潜力与表达。

**Citation limits / 引用边界**: A genus label cannot establish a universal substrate preference, and this host/oil-seep context differs from methane-only habitats.

属名不能确定普遍底物偏好，该宿主／石油冷泉背景也不同于仅甲烷生境。

**Discussion use / 讨论用途**: Use for functional variation within familiar taxa and hydrocarbon-based animal symbioses beyond methanotrophy.

用于讨论熟悉类群内部的功能变化及甲烷氧化之外的烃供能动物共生。

加的斯湾不同活动泥火山的细菌与微真核生物

Coelho, F. J. R. C., Louvado, A., Domingues, P. M., Cleary, D. F. R., Ferreira, M., Almeida, A., Cunha, M. R., Cunha, Â., & Gomes, N. C. M. (2016). **Study scope / 研究范围**: Differently active Gulf of Cádiz mud volcanoes and a non-seeping reference site on the southwest Iberian margin.

伊比利亚西南陆缘加的斯湾不同活动泥火山及一处非渗漏参照站。

用 16S／18S rRNA 标记及相关分析表征沉积物细菌与微真核生物。

**Finding / 发现**: More active sites differed in bacterial and eukaryotic composition, with enriched Methylococcales and lobose amoebae and correlated distributions.

较活跃站位的细菌及真核组成不同，Methylococcales 与叶足变形虫富集且分布相关。
